$comment: Default Management UI deployment config. In dev (no VITE_PROXY_TARGET) the shell serves THIS file at /ui/config/management-ui/config.json — edit it and reload to test config changes without a backend. It also ships inside the JAR as the shipped default; production deployments mount their own config.json over it at the same path. Anything omitted here falls back to defaultConfig in @oc-mui/ui-config; plugins contribute their own slice defaults at runtime.
